title: Reveal response
description: Planned (owner decision HR-1, basalt_meta versions 29 and 30). The 200 answer of POST /api/v1/approvals/{approvalId}/reveal and POST /api/v1/reverts/{revertId}/reveal, built by basalt_meta.reveal_approval_rows or reveal_revert_rows and sent with Cache-Control: no-store. One entry per redacted line of the request, in line order. A row without secretColumns is shown only after sha256(utf8(row)) equals that line's rowHash, so the engine and the Vault cannot change its values. A row with secretColumns cannot be checked on the page (rowHash hashes the whole row text): the page accepts it only when every value of those columns is null and labels it not checked against what the person signs, never as checked. See CONTRACT.md, Approvals, Rows hidden from the agent.

line.description: The 0-based index of the redacted line in the request's lines (an approval's preview lines, or a revert's lines or a large plan's sample).

row.description: The exact text of [key, old, set] (approval) or [key, now, set] (revert) written by the text rules (CONTRACT.md, Stores, Text rules; in Postgres jsonb_build_array(…)): the text the line's rowHash hashes. Every SECRET column is null wherever it appears.

secretColumns.description: The SECRET columns (PII classification) set to null in row, by column name. Absent when there are none. Such a row cannot hash to its rowHash and is unverified on the page: shown with those columns as 'secret · not shown', and the row labelled not checked against what the person signs.
